configuration_notation.candidate_boundary: observed candidates only; not universal recommendations or accepted production settings

measurement_basis: Client first-content/end timing at the inference-worker read boundary; mean token interval uses reported completion tokens.
comparison_scope: within-runtime paired target-only versus EAGLE-3; no cross-runtime ranking
claim_boundary: Latency differences are descriptive. Exact-output hashes differ and the task-specific oracle was unavailable; no correctness or losslessness claim is made.

excluded_source.reason: all requests returned HTTP 400 after an incompatible streaming telemetry option; retained only as setup-failure/RCA evidence

telemetry.draft_miss_rate_definition: per-request ratio: 1 - accepted draft tokens / proposed draft tokens
telemetry.aggregate_rejected_proposed_definition: sum(proposed - accepted) / sum(proposed); not a median of per-request ratios

quantile_method: linear interpolation over available nonnegative finite observed values
cleanup: identified owned allocations permanently deleted; direct not-found and empty inventory verified
